name: Tuna Lasagna
steps: Make the bechamel (or substitute 500ml cooking cream): melt the butter, whisk in the flour, cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Wilt the spinach briefly and mix it through the drained tuna.
In a baking dish, layer: crushed tomato sauce, lasagna sheets, tuna-spinach mix, bechamel, repeat until ingredients are used, finishing with a bechamel layer.
Top with torn mozzarella and grated parmesan.
Bake at 190°C for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Great for batch freezing — assemble a second tray unbaked and freeze half for midweek.
